subject: Re: ClearShare onboarding — PO token mismatch & capped line corrections
messages:
From: Sally Turner <sally.turner@clearshare.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, priyom_das@redwood.example
Cc: ap@clearshare.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: ClearShare onboarding request and PO details

Hi Karthik / Priyom,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. We attached our completed onboarding form and the provisional PO reference our ERP generated — the line items are split across two internal projects and the spend cap on the larger line is currently lower than expected. Can your procurement team help:

- Confirm whether Redwood can issue two PO tokens (one per internal project) or a single PO with sub-line codes.
- Temporarily increase the spend cap on the primary line to cover initial consumption while our AP confirms budgets.
- Provide any required attachments (SOC2 attestation, invoice routing code) so we can finalize entry in our system.

Attachments: ClearShare_onboarding_form_v1.pdf (PDF, 430 KB), provisional_po_request.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

Sally Turner
Procurement Manager
ClearShare Inc.
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
To: Sally Turner <sally.turner@clearshare.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.example, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example, monica_patel@redwood.example
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearShare onboarding request and PO details

Hi Sally — thanks for the form and the PO stub. Quick notes and next steps from our side: 

Summary of issue: the provisional PO line (PR-4489) is flagged by our issuance rules because the requested cap (USD 225k) exceeds the default onboarding cap (USD 100k) for first 30 days. That explains the mismatch you saw.

Options we can execute today:
1) Issue two distinct PO tokens (PO-CRS-2026-015A and PO-CRS-2026-015B) tied to your two internal projects — each with its own spend cap.
2) Issue a single PO and apply an internal split code, but that requires ClearShare AP to accept sub-line routing and will delay activation by 2–3 business days.
3) Provision a temporary overage hold (30% buffer) on PO-CRS-2026-015 while we await budget confirmation; this is a short-term exception and must be signed off by procurement leads.

What I need from you to proceed immediately:
- Confirm whether ClearShare prefers separate PO tokens (Option 1) or a single PO with sub-lines (Option 2).
- If Option 3 is required, please reply with an internal approver name and a preferred expiration date for the temporary increase.

I’m looping in Priyom and Vanessa to coordinate the token issuance and accounting tags. I will draft the amended line-item breakdown and send the PO numbers for signature once we have your selection.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_summary_v2.pdf (PDF, 110 KB) — referenced for AP]

To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example
Cc: Sally Turner <sally.turner@clearshare.com>, monica_patel@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearShare onboarding request and PO details

Karthik, Vanessa —

We should go with Option 1 (two PO tokens). Reasoning:
- Clear allocation per project prevents double-counting across their internal cost centers.
- We can set staggered spend caps immediately: primary project = USD 180k (temporary), secondary project = USD 45k.
- This avoids having to rely on their AP to accept sub-line routing which has historically taken 48–72 hours.

Operational impact:
- I will open a provisional issuance ticket and request PO-CRS-2026-015A and PO-CRS-2026-015B.
- Vanessa, please prepare the accounting tags: GL=4102, COST_CENTER=CS-PX, and include the hubspot deal id in the memo.

Sally — if that works, please confirm and I’ll push the tokens to the DocuSign flow for your AP signature. If you need a different temporary cap on the primary line, state the amount.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearShare onboarding request and PO details — tokens issued

Sally / ClearShare AP —

Thanks for confirming intent to split. We have issued two provisional PO tokens as requested and pushed them into the DocuSign flow:

- PO-CRS-2026-015A — primary project — spend cap USD 180,000 (temporary, expires 2026-06-03)
- PO-CRS-2026-015B — secondary project — spend cap USD 45,000

Notes and actions completed:
- Priyom created the issuance ticket (#ISS-6641) and attached the amended line-item spreadsheet.
- Vanessa applied accounting tags (GL=4102, COST_CENTER=CS-PX).
- I attached an amended_lineitem_proposal.xlsx showing the split and the memo text we included in the DocuSign package.

Attachments: amended_lineitem_proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)

Next steps for ClearShare AP:
1) Review the DocuSign package and sign both tokens. Link: https://docusign.net/clearshare/flow/ABC12345
2) Once signed, notify ap@clearshare.com and copy monica_patel@redwood.example so we can finalize routing.

If you want the temporary cap shortened or extended, reply with the approver name and new expiration date and we will update the ticket.

Thanks — looping in Monica to confirm the final ledger post-signature.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
